expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: Full component with type definitions, mutation signatures, state management, and JSX rendering

expectations.text: Produces actual working component code rather than only a list of recommendations
expectations.evidence: Exports DocumentBulkActions React component with hooks and complete implementation

expectations.text: Makes the destructive action recoverable rather than relying on a confirmation dialog alone
expectations.evidence: Delete uses only type-to-confirm dialog; no recovery mechanism like soft-delete, grace period, or undo. Archive mentions 'In a real implementation: trigger a "Documents archived. [Undo]" toast here' but this is only for archive, not the destructive delete action

expectations.text: Shows the count of affected items before the action is taken
expectations.evidence: selectedCount displayed in bulk actions bar: 'span className="font-semibold text-gray-900"> {selectedCount} document{selectedCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} selected'

expectations.text: Distinguishes select-all-on-page from select-all-matching rather than conflating them
expectations.evidence: Explicit isAllOnPageSelected vs selectAllMatching logic; shows 'Select all {totalMatchingCount} matching documents' button conditionally

expectations.text: Separates the destructive action from the benign one visually or spatially
expectations.evidence: Archive button is gray/white with border; Delete button is red-600 with red text. Separated by border divider.

expectations.text: Does not make the destructive action the default focus or primary button
expectations.evidence: Delete modal input receives focus via placeholder, not the delete button. Archive appears first in button order.

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: Device notes section does not mention server-side enforcement requirements

expectations.text: Closes by naming which misuses the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Device notes explicitly state: 'Scope escalation and double submission are impossible' and 'Accidental deletion requires work'
